name: Why should an optometry practice in New York City consider AEO over traditional advertising?

mainEntity.name: Why should an optometry practice in New York City consider AEO over traditional advertising?

acceptedAnswer.text: In a competitive market like New York City, AEO offers a data-driven advantage over traditional advertising methods. AEO targets patients actively searching for eye care online, leading to higher-quality leads than broad, untargeted campaigns. It provides measurable ROI by tracking organic traffic, patient inquiries, and conversions, allowing for continuous refinement of strategies. This often results in a more cost-effective and efficient patient acquisition model compared to traditional advertising's broader reach.
acceptedAnswer.description: AEO in New York City targets active online searchers, offering measurable ROI and efficient patient acquisition, unlike broad traditional advertising.
